# SCE Embed Package — sce_core (header-only) + sce_base (static library)
#
# Generated by: scripts/package_embed.sh
# Repository:   https://github.com/newmassrael/scxml-core-engine
#
# Consumer integration:
#   add_subdirectory(third_party/sce)
#   target_link_libraries(my_app PRIVATE sce_base)
#
# Options:
#   SCE_USE_SPDLOG  — Use bundled spdlog for logging (default: OFF)
#                     Set OFF if consumer already provides spdlog.

option(SCE_USE_SPDLOG "Use SCE-bundled spdlog for logging" OFF)

# Version tracking — consumer can verify generated SM headers match this version
if(EXISTS "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/VERSION")
    file(READ "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/VERSION" SCE_EMBED_VERSION)
    string(STRIP "${SCE_EMBED_VERSION}" SCE_EMBED_VERSION)
    message(STATUS "SCE embed: version ${SCE_EMBED_VERSION}")
endif()

# ============================================================================
# Third-party: nlohmann/json (header-only)
# Use consumer-provided target if available, otherwise use bundled copy.
# ============================================================================
if(TARGET nlohmann_json::nlohmann_json)
    set(SCE_NLOHMANN_JSON_TARGET nlohmann_json::nlohmann_json)
    message(STATUS "SCE embed: using consumer-provided nlohmann_json")
else()
    set(SCE_NLOHMANN_JSON_INCLUDE_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/third_party/nlohmann_json/include")
endif()

# ============================================================================
# Third-party: pugixml (header-only, compilation unit in sce_runtime only)
# ============================================================================
set(SCE_PUGIXML_INCLUDE_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/third_party/pugixml/src")

# ============================================================================
# sce_core: Header-only core library for AOT standalone usage
# ============================================================================
# Contains: StaticExecutionEngine, Helper classes, core algorithms
# All SCE_LOG_* macros are no-ops when SCE_ENABLE_RUNTIME_LOGGING is not defined.
add_library(sce_core INTERFACE)

target_include_directories(sce_core
    INTERFACE
        $<BUILD_INTERFACE:${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/include>
        $<BUILD_INTERFACE:${SCE_PUGIXML_INCLUDE_DIR}>
)

# nlohmann_json: prefer consumer target, fall back to bundled include path
if(SCE_NLOHMANN_JSON_TARGET)
    target_link_libraries(sce_core INTERFACE ${SCE_NLOHMANN_JSON_TARGET})
else()
    target_include_directories(sce_core INTERFACE
        $<BUILD_INTERFACE:${SCE_NLOHMANN_JSON_INCLUDE_DIR}>
    )
endif()

target_compile_features(sce_core INTERFACE cxx_std_17)

# ============================================================================
# sce_base: Compiled base utilities for AOT (no script engine dependency)
# ============================================================================
# Contains: Logger, UniqueIdGenerator, ScriptResultUtils, EventDataHelper, etc.
# Pure static AOT consumers link only sce_base (no QuickJS/Lua).
#
# Source list: sce_base_sources.cmake (SSOT — shared with in-tree build)
include(${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/sce_base_sources.cmake)

add_library(sce_base
    ${SCE_BASE_SOURCES}
    $<$<BOOL:${SCE_USE_SPDLOG}>:${SCE_BASE_SPDLOG_SOURCES}>
)

target_include_directories(sce_base
    PUBLIC
        $<BUILD_INTERFACE:${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/include/common>
    # include/scripting is PRIVATE: sce_base's own .cpp files need it to
    # resolve unqualified short-name headers (XMLDOMWrapper/SessionRegistry/
    # ScriptResultUtils/EcmaScriptToLuaTransformer), but tier-respecting
    # embed consumers link sce_base without inheriting the scripting flat
    # path. Matches sce/CMakeLists.txt — a tier-scoped path stays tier-scoped
    # even in the lightweight embed package.
    PRIVATE
        $<BUILD_INTERFACE:${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/include/scripting>
)

target_link_libraries(sce_base
    PUBLIC
        sce_core
)

# spdlog (optional, bundled header-only)
if(SCE_USE_SPDLOG)
    if(EXISTS "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/third_party/spdlog/include")
        target_include_directories(sce_base PUBLIC
            $<BUILD_INTERFACE:${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/third_party/spdlog/include>
        )
        target_compile_definitions(sce_base PUBLIC
            SCE_USE_SPDLOG
            SPDLOG_HEADER_ONLY=1
            SPDLOG_FMT_EXTERNAL=0
        )
    else()
        message(WARNING "SCE: SCE_USE_SPDLOG=ON but bundled spdlog not found, using DefaultBackend")
    endif()
endif()

# Runtime logging: PRIVATE so only sce_base TUs take the
# SCE_ENABLE_RUNTIME_LOGGING branch. External consumers fall through to
# the no-op branch in LogMacros.h and don't need spdlog at compile time.
target_compile_definitions(sce_base PRIVATE SCE_ENABLE_RUNTIME_LOGGING)

# Force include DisableStdOut.h for sce_base source files only.
# ExternTemplates.h suppresses implicit std::basic_string<char>
# instantiation so consumers linking libsce_base.a don't drag archive
# members via std::string weak-symbol resolution. See the header for
# details; mirrored from sce/CMakeLists.txt for parity with in-tree builds.
if(MSVC)
    target_compile_options(sce_base PRIVATE /FI"common/ExternTemplates.h" /FI"common/DisableStdOut.h")
else()
    target_compile_options(sce_base PRIVATE
        "SHELL:-include common/ExternTemplates.h"
        "SHELL:-include common/DisableStdOut.h"
    )
endif()

target_compile_features(sce_base PUBLIC cxx_std_17)
